scene: Inside the rumbling tow truck cab, a glowing neon dachshund buzzes softly.
beats: The neon dog lets out a crackling bark and sputters blue, right as the truck brakes smoothly inside the hospital bay.
A fuzzy synth melody fills the cab, synchronising with the rainbow glow as the truck rolls through the workshop gates.
The driver chuckles and hands you a phosphor voucher just as the truck pulls up beside glass-blowing benches.
picture: A side view inside the truck cab. Far left, a pink neon dachshund glows on the vinyl bench. Left of centre, the player sits wearing his corduroy jacket and beanie. Centre, the dashboard has a chunky CB radio. Right, a scaly green driver steers. Rooftops recede outside the wide window.
shown: a buzzy pink neon dachshund resting on the bench on the far left
a bulky retro CB radio mounted on the dashboard at the centre
a friendly reptilian driver gripping the wide steering wheel on the right
